description: Pulls UN Comtrade trade-flow data for ocean-freight prospect research; given country + HS code, returns who imports what from where.

novel_features.name: Country lookup
novel_features.description: Fuzzy-search Comtrade country reporters by name, ISO2, ISO3, or numeric code.

novel_features.name: HS code search
novel_features.description: Fuzzy-search HS6 commodity codes by code prefix or text description.

novel_features.name: Annual import volumes
novel_features.description: Annual import volume for a country/HS pair from a specific partner (default China).

novel_features.name: Composite prospect-fit score
novel_features.description: 0-100 score combining China-share of imports, year-over-year growth, and route coverage.
